method_notes: lygte-info publishes capacity only as PNG charts (Volt vs Ah, two cells A/B at 0.2..30A). Delivered capacity = x position of the end of each cell-A curve at the 2.8 V axis floor, pixel-extracted from the raw PNG with axis ticks calibrated from the gridlines; uncertainty about +-30 mAh. Currents above 15 A dropped (cells stopped hot before cutoff, legend colour mapping less certain).
Cutoff 2.8 V is the tester lower limit stated on lygte 18650 summary page ("that is my lower test limit"); 21700 pages share the same chart floor (2.8 V) but state no text.
Cell-A curve only; cell-B tracks within about 1-2 percent.
missing: LiPo (RC pack) measured capacity vs discharge current: no text-readable independent test found (lygte-info lists only cylindrical Li-ion cells; web search returned only theory pages)

Capacity vs temperature (Li-ion and LiPo): no text-readable measured source found; Molicel/Samsung datasheet temperature curves are charts only, third-party copy gives only 45C >=4.00Ah (P42A), not used
Li-ion Ri vs temperature has only two temperatures (warm about 22C, cold about -1..0C) so fewer than 4 temperature points
Internal resistance under load from lygte (Ri chart) is only in summary bar chart images, not extracted
21700 pouch-format cell not tested separately (21700 cylindrical used)
